blocks.text: Panel A shows point estimates; no new intervals are introduced. Internal validation contains 133 patients; external evaluation contains 102 episodes from 50 patients. Core4 = INR/PLT/ALBI/FIB-4; raw-only intersection = INR/PLT; composite intersection = PTAR/FIB-4. Candidate-pool rules are in Note M3.
blocks.display_html: Panel A shows point estimates; no new intervals are introduced. Internal validation contains 133 patients; external evaluation contains 102 episodes from 50 patients. Core4 = INR/PLT/ALBI/FIB-4; raw-only intersection = INR/PLT; composite intersection = PTAR/FIB-4. Candidate-pool rules are in Note M3.

blocks.text: Panel B retains all six ablations. ΔAUROC and ΔAP = FULL minus ablation; Brier improvement = ablation minus FULL. Positive values favor FULL. Original paired 95% percentile intervals use 5,000 patient draws internally and patient-cluster draws externally. Intervals spanning zero do not establish equivalence or absence of contribution. See Note M3.

blocks.text: Abbreviations: AUROC, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; AP, average precision; CITL, calibration-in-the-large; CI, confidence interval; RBF-SVM, radial-basis-function support vector machine; PTAR, study-defined 10 × INR/albumin (albumin in g/L); INR, international normalized ratio; PLT, platelet count; ALBI, albumin-bilirubin score; FIB-4, fibrosis-4 index.
